kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi run-ai-helper-writing --workspace-id llm-xxxxx --writing-scene media --writing-style '通知' --prompt '请帮我写一篇关于人工智能发展趋势的文章' --prompt-mode Template --distribute-writing false --writing-params wordCount=1000 tone=formal --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunAiHelperWriting

parameters.help_en: The writing scenario. Valid values: government, media, market, office, and custom
parameters.help_zh: 写作场景：government(政务)、media(传媒)、market(营销)、office(办公)、custom(自定义)
parameters.name: writing_scene

parameters.help_en: The unique key for the writing style. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922609.html operation to get a list of styles for the specified scenario
parameters.help_zh: 写作文体唯一标识KEY，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922609.html接口获取对应写作场景下的文体列表
parameters.name: writing_style

parameters.example: 请帮我写一篇关于人工智能发展趋势的文章
parameters.help_en: The prompt, which specifies the subject for the AI to write about
parameters.help_zh: 提示词，需要帮写的主题
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: The prompt pattern. For example, PE indicates the advanced pattern and Template indicates the template pattern
parameters.help_zh: 提示词模式，如：PE：高级模式，Template：模板模式
parameters.name: prompt_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to generate the text step by step
parameters.name: distribute_writing

parameters.help_en: The writing parameters from the previous form, specified as key-value pairs
parameters.help_zh: 上一次表单的写作参数，键值对形式
parameters.name: writing_params
